newsitem.title: NORWAY: Kvaerner says in 1.9 bln NOK Egypt deal.
newsitem.headline: Kvaerner says in 1.9 bln NOK Egypt deal.

text.p: Norwegian industrial group Kvaerner ASA said on Tuesday its subsidiary Kvaerner Construction was part of an international consortium that had won a 1.9 billion crown Egyptian contract.
A Kvaerner spokeswoman said Kvaerner Construction held two-thirds of the contract to build a studio for the Egyptian state-owned broadcast company ERTU.
Kvaerner said in a statement to the Oslo Bourse that the consortium also included Sony Broadcast of Japan and Professional Europe.
"The contract is divided approximately into two-thirds civil engineering and construction and one third systems integration, engineering and production equipment," the statement said.
The 420,000 square metre studio will be built outside Cairo.
